summary: Deduplicated discussion-sourced signals: vendor agent releases (Google Gemini, Meta Muse), security reports (DeepSeek API key leak, Grok Slack data exposure), infra updates (Runtime sandboxes, Claude Code fixes), operator tips and adoption signals (container isolation, coding-agent waste). Prioritize vendor releases and high-impact security/infra chatter for follow-up. | Vendor updates across agents, sandboxes, and security: AWS & Cloudflare platform deltas, GHSA Pydantic AI advisories, E2B/Modal sandbox/runtime features, plus customer case studies from AWS and X (Grok). | GitHub-only snapshot: multiple vendor releases (Vercel, Cloudflare, Google, OpenAI) plus notable infra repos (computer-use, cloud browser, agent security). No social/discussion reports in this shard; several infra projects need social corroboration before promotion. | Package-sourced pulse: strong vendor packages from Vercel, Amazon, OpenAI plus many MCP/sandbox/memory/eval primitives; missing social/operator reports for real-world workflows.
